perspectives.query: why do good conversations make time fly by
perspectives.insight: When you are really clicking with someone, your attention locks into the flow of ideas and humor so naturally that you stop watching the clock.

perspectives.query: how do i figure out what i really enjoy doing
perspectives.insight: Pay attention to the things you gravitate toward on a free Saturday afternoon when nobody is grading you or expecting anything.

perspectives.insight: The trick is keeping a sense of humor and curiosity—big questions do not need fancy words when we connect them to real human moments.
